column4: and all ye ends of the earth
column5: hearken unto these words and believe in Christ; and if ye believe not in these words believe in Christ. And if ye shall believe in Christ ye will believe in these words
column6: for they are the words of Christ
column7: and he hath given them unto me; and they teach all men that they should do good. 11 And if they are not the words of Christ
column8: judge ye—for Christ will show unto you
column11: at the last day; and you and I shall stand face to face before his bar; and ye shall know that I have been commanded of him to write these things
